title: TIGA: Towards Efficient Near Data Processing in SmartNICs-based Disaggregated Memory Systems
problem: Current SoC-based SmartNICs suffer from inefficient resource allocation for near-data processing engines and lack effective collaboration mechanisms between SmartNICs on data nodes and CPUs on compute nodes in disaggregated memory systems.
motivation: Memory disaggregation via SmartNICs enables cost-effective memory resource sharing in data centers, but current implementations cannot efficiently exploit this architecture for near-data processing.
method: TIGA introduces an adaptive resource allocator that dynamically distributes SoC cores among NDP engines for optimal utilization, combined with a SmartNIC-CPU cooperative computing mechanism that schedules NDP tasks intelligently across both SmartNICs and CPUs. The framework is prototyped using FPGAs and evaluated on typical workloads.
key_novelty: SmartNIC-CPU cooperative computing mechanism for intelligent scheduling and resource allocation in disaggregated memory systems.
contributions: Adaptive resource allocator for efficient SoC core utilization across NDP engines
SmartNIC-CPU cooperative computing framework enabling collaborative task scheduling
FPGA prototype demonstrating significant efficiency improvements over state-of-the-art approaches

metrics.speedup: Significant improvement in NDP task efficiency
metrics.other: efficiency gains compared to SmartNIC-based co-processing schemes

primary_theme: efficient near-data processing in disaggregated memory systems
